Amanda T.: quick idea — add a compact inline estimator on pricing (small footprint, CTA tied to webinar) + tighten FAQ accordion. low-effort, high-signal? Lia Chen: love it. what’s the primary metric — trial starts or webinar signups? Amanda T.: primary = trial starts (7-day), secondary = webinar signups. also watch /pricing bounce. Rob S.: two variants: (A) compact estimator with monthly/yearly and savings badge, (B) same but CTA nudges committed discount ("See committed savings"). A/B test. Pranav K.: routing: if estimator output > $5k/mo, tag lead "enterprise-pkg" and send to SDR webhook. use existing lead-webhook. Julia M.: micro-FAQ suggested copy: "How do you calculate tokens?" -> "Estimate uses sample workload assumptions — adjust seq length and concurrency for refined numbers." Amanda T.: +1. also try collapsing some FAQ rows into tooltips to reduce perceived length. Rob S.: experiment length: 2 weeks or until 1k estimator uses? Lia Chen: 1k uses. success criteria: +6% trial-starts or +12% webinar CTR. marketing-bot: deploy snippet ready for staging:
Pranav K.: lead-tagging config for eng: { "threshold_usd_per_month":5000, "tag":"enterprise-pkg", "webhook":"/hooks/sdr" } Julia M.: microcopy variants: A) "Estimated monthly cost" B) "Typical monthly spend (estimate)" C) "Starting monthly cost — refine with your settings" Amanda T.: run A vs C. C might reduce dropoff. Rob S.: eng-runtime: lazy-load estimator after LCP; must not add >50ms to page load. Pranav K.: noted. Lia Chen: checklist: tracking events (estimator_open, estimator_submit, estimator_cta_click), GA mapping, experiment flag, email routing rules. Amanda T.: I'll draft experiment doc and dashboards (conversions by estimator bands, lead tags, 14-day retention snapshot). Lia will own analysis. Julia M.: I'll post micro-FAQ draft to #docs in 24h. marketing-bot: staging deploy scheduled @ 2026-09-12T18:00Z. :rocket: Rob S.: tagging eng-runtime and growth for visibility. :eyes: Amanda T.: thanks — will post A/B variants and runbook by EOD. :thumbsup:
